en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Couple on the Rooted (Sahetukaduka)
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-root-conditioned, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and root-conditioned by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-root-conditioned, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and root-conditioned by way of root-condition. [Dependent on] a state that is non-visible, non-reacting...

Dependent on a state that is non-causal, non-demonstrable, and impinging, and also dependent on a state that is non-causal, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-impinging, and causal by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, impinging, and non-causal, there arises a state that is demonstrable, impinging, and non-causal by way of the root condition; ... seven.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible-and-reacting and rootless, there arises a state that is non-visible-and-reacting and rootless by way of root-condition … seven.

Dependent on a state that is both non-visible-and-reacting and rootless and a state that is non-visible-and-reacting and rootless, there arises a state that is non-visible-and-reacting and rootless by way of root-condition … seven. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, twenty-one; in the object condition, three ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, twenty-one.
